Needs changes before merge.

The highlight tests pass. Both reported mutations fail as stated and pass after restoration. The geometry lookup tests also pass.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes geometry lookup and selection resolution used by operation generation. No golden files moved.

Local results

I attempted a trial merge with upstream/main at `e808c96299ef7e1edb3206d327acc270847a8a18`. It has code conflicts in nine files:

- `crates/app/src/model/geometry.rs`
- `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs`
- `crates/app/src/operation/stitch.rs`
- `crates/app/src/pick/feature_sel.rs`
- `crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`

I aborted the trial merge. All results below apply to the PR head alone. They do not validate integration with current main. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build geometry, app and UI library tests with `--no-run` | Pass |
| Geometry library tests | 48 passed |
| App library tests | 352 passed, 1 ignored |
| App suites: `area_chains`, `area_picks`, `commands_undo`, `dirty_flag`, `face_origin`, `feature`, `feature_pick`, `stitch_cross` | 75 passed |
| UI library tests, from `crates/ui` | 951 passed, 6 ignored |
| Clippy for geometry, app and UI, `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |

The quick gate plan falls back to batch because geometry changed. I ran the checks above, not the full batch or release gate. Pixel snapshots and live window frame timing were not run.

Mutations repeated locally:

1. Replace `pick_ink.rs` with upstream/main's version: all four `highlight_perf` tests fail. The three-piece test reports 180 shapes. Restore the PR file: all four pass.
2. Disable both cache-hit conditions in `pick_highlight.rs`: the selection-build test fails on frame 0, with 2 builds instead of 1. Restore the PR file: all four pins pass.

Requested before merge

1. **[P2] Keep the source allocation valid in the vertex cache.** `crates/ui/src/frame_cache.rs:258` matches only the numeric facet address, length and pose. `WorldVertsEntry` keeps no source `Arc` or `Weak`. Its key also has no document revision. When the last source reference is dropped, another mesh can use the same address. The cache then returns the old vertices. A temporary local probe confirmed this with two different `Arc<[Triangle]>` allocations at the same address. The second lookup returned x = 10 instead of x = 20. This can show an old model or stock after source geometry is replaced or released. Keep and check a source `Weak<[Triangle]>`, or use a key that cannot survive source replacement. Add a test for source release and address reuse. The probe was removed after the check.

2. **Add the required before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** `crates/ui/src/pick_highlight_mesh.rs:136` changes highlight rendering, but the body has no screenshots. Show the selected edges, the hovered edge and a welded face before and after the change. Store the images only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.

The PR remains a draft. The code conflicts require a refresh at merge time under the current upstream rules. All temporary review edits were restored. No contributor code was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: none. The required merge stopped because both sides changed the same logic. No fix was committed or pushed.

The latest review requests two changes:
1. Keep and check a source Weak in the vertex cache. Add a pin for source release and address reuse.
2. Add before/after screenshots for selected edges, a hovered edge, and a welded face. Store them on the fork's pr-screenshots branch.

Conflict evidence from git merge upstream/main:
- crates/app/src/model/geometry.rs, features_of_shared: the PR uses SHARED_FEATURES_CACHE and pointer comparisons. Main adds a public implementation with SHARED_FEATURES, Weak::ptr_eq, and digest instrumentation.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs, collect: the PR adds collect_shared and persistent scene caching. Main wraps scene collection in frame_memo::scene_scope.
- crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs, drive_chains and selection_geometry_in: the PR calls feature::resolve_chain_arc. Main calls crate::model::resolve_chain.

These are changes to the same logic. The author-side instructions require a stop instead of a guessed resolution. I aborted the merge and removed the worktree. Tests, mutation checks, the quick gate, and clippy did not run. No screenshots were added.

The head remains 1c279c1ddb1754b2f8c8995ffd740422254a1d92. Please re-review the conflict evidence and specify the required integration before another fix attempt.

Fixed both findings on `1c279c1dd`.

1. **Vertex cache source lifetime:** `WorldVertsEntry` in `crates/ui/src/frame_cache.rs` now stores `Weak<[Triangle]>` instead of a raw pointer address. `FrameCache::world_verts_cached` prunes entries with `strong_count() == 0` and checks live pointer identity with `facets_len` and `pose`. Pinned by `frame_cache::tests::world_verts_cached_does_not_reuse_stale_entry_after_source_release` and `frame_cache::tests::world_collect_rebuilds_vertices_when_model_facets_are_replaced` in `crates/ui/src/frame_cache_tests.rs` (both failed when reverted to raw `facets_ptr` and passed when restored).
2. **Before/after UI screenshots:** Captured real `1280x720` shell and `View3D` before (`1f15f98e7`) and after (`b654e0502`) renders showing selected edges, the hovered edge, and a welded face. Stored the 6 PNGs only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `3441230386b638c8bfd4478b8cb22b908ff25aad`. `gh pr edit` failed here due to the GitHub `projectCards` GraphQL deprecation in `gh 2.46.0` (and `gh api` PATCH is blocked by sandbox policy), so the table is included below for linking in the PR body.

   - Pin: `frame_cache::tests::world_collect_rebuilds_vertices_when_model_facets_are_replaced`.

Gate on `b654e0502`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (batch fallback) passed 10 of 10 steps. Clippy on geometry, app and UI with `-D warnings` passed.

This step changed only the PR body. No new commit was pushed.

The conflicts with `upstream/main` stay. Both sides changed the same logic in `features_of_shared`, `world::collect` and `selection::drive_chains`. The refresh happens at merge time.

Please re-review.

```text
assertion `left == right` failed: the setup draft takes the point: no vertex under the cursor
  left: 0
 right: 1
```

I repeated two mutations locally:

1. Replace `pick_ink.rs` with the current main version. All four `highlight_perf` tests fail. The three-piece test reports 180 shapes. Restore the PR file: all four pass.
2. Disable both cache-hit conditions in `pick_highlight.rs`. The selection-build test fails on frame 0, with 2 builds instead of 1. Restore the PR file: all four highlight tests pass.

Requested before merge

1. **Add the required tests for the other display caches.** `crates/ui/src/panel_cache.rs:77` adds six caches. `crates/ui/src/frame_cache.rs:290`, `:323`, and `:354` add region, toolpath-line, and scene caches. The new tests count selected-highlight builds and test vertex-source replacement. They do not count builds or test input changes for these other caches. Current upstream `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`, under "Frame cost", requires a counter test and a changed-input test for each cache. Add tests that show no new build when inputs stay unchanged. Then change the relevant input and check the new output. Cover the status and warning data, geometry and selection data, toolpath replacement, and scene visibility. Keep these tests independent of `selection_builds`: that counter can pass while another cache is stale or rebuilds each frame.

This is a gap against the current upstream rule. It is separate from the two earlier findings, which are addressed.

The maintainer decided today (2026-11-17) that a maintainer agent takes over issue #2201. It is a `P1` and holds the next release cut.

The agent starts a new branch from `main`. It adds the caches of this pull request that `main` does not have, with the build-count and changed-input tests that the review asked for. It credits this pull request.

This pull request stays open. Its author decides when to close it.
This seems tries to fix same FPS bug we fixed in another story - we should compare the solutions and determine which survives. And make a note of it.

﻿## Comparison: this PR, `main` and PR #2331 (the same frame cost of issue #2201)

The maintainer asked for a comparison of the solutions. This comment gives it. It is read-only work: no code, no labels and no branch changed.

Refs compared:
- This PR: head `b654e0502`, merge base `1f15f98e7`.
- `main`: `d3e779907`.
- PR #2331: branch `issue/2201-frame-caches`, head `3f6893e06`.

All file paths and line numbers below come from `git show <ref>:<path>`.

### The rule that decides most rows

`crates/ui/AGENTS.md` lines 43-48 on `main` (decision #2238): "The cache key is the input: the value, an `Arc` that a change replaces, or a revision that the input's one writer bumps. Never `doc_version` alone." It also asks for a counter test and a changed-input test for each cache.

This PR keys most caches on `WorldStamp` (`crates/ui/src/frame_cache.rs:23-38`). That is `doc_version`, `selection_version` and `History::revision_token`. These are global counters, not the input. The UI has about 95 hand-written `doc_version += 1` sites. A write that misses a bump gives a stale display and no error. The PR's own tests bump it by hand (for example `highlight_perf.rs:123`).

Private function. | `SHARED_FEATURES`, `model/geometry.rs:46-90`: a `Weak` and `Weak::ptr_eq` (line 72). Public. A `DIGESTS` counter (line 57, `feature_digests()` line 95) that the #2235 pins read. | Equal key law: both hold the `Weak`, so the address cannot be reused. `main` has the counter and the pins. | `main` survives.
